def evolved_p93(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i] = i XOR (i >> 1) -- binary-reflected Gray code.
    # Compute XOR bit-by-bit using arithmetic (no bitwise ops available).
    i = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    ishift = i // 2
    g = torch.zeros(N, device=x.device)
    p = 1
    for b in range(8):
        abit = (i // p) % 2
        bbit = (ishift // p) % 2
        xbit = (abit + bbit) % 2
        g = g + xbit * p
        p = p * 2
    return g.to(x.dtype)
